observation: Side A's page is about five times taller than B's at the same 1440px width.
evidence: A page_height 29448 vs B 5774; both page_width 1440. A was cut into 23 slices, B into 5.

observation: The two pages have different document titles. A's title is SEO-style with a 'Top US … Blogger' phrase; B's names the brand and author with an em dash.
evidence: A: 'Top US Interior Design and DIY Projects Blogger | Never Skip Brunch'. B: 'Never Skip Brunch — DIY & Home Design by Cara Newhart'.

observation: The H1 text and styling differ. A's H1 is the centered brand name in caps; B's H1 is the welcome line, larger and start-aligned.
evidence: A h1 'NEVER SKIP BRUNCH', 50px playfair, centered. B h1 'welcome to never skip brunch.', 73.6px 'Playfair Display', text-align start, shown in italic in B_slice_00.

observation: A uses Poppins as its main typeface and mixes in several others. B uses three families with Jost as the body face.
evidence: A fonts: poppins 403, montserrat 55+25, trirong 25, moontime 14, playfair 9. B fonts: Jost 196, Caveat 13, Playfair Display 10.

observation: A's script accents ('the blog', 'as seen in', 'join the newsletter') are image or Moontime-style script. B uses Caveat in pink for small eyebrow labels above its headings.
evidence: B_slice_01–03 show pink handwritten labels ('projects & tips', 'a home design show', '@neverskipbrunch'). A_slice_03 and A_slice_11 show a thin black script ('the blog', 'join the newsletter.').

observation: The body background differs: A is pure white, B is a warm cream.
evidence: A body_bg rgb(255,255,255); B body_bg rgb(255,250,241).

observation: The accent colors differ. A's text accent is a golden yellow/orange; B introduces a magenta-pink accent.
evidence: A top text colors include rgb(243,179,79) ×136 and rgb(178,133,48) ×20. B includes rgb(230,25,107) ×21 as text and ×3 as background.

observation: The announcement bar is styled differently. A's is a split yellow/peach bar with condensed caps and a script link; B's is a solid magenta bar with small white sentence-case text and an underlined link.
evidence: A_slice_00: 'FUN & FRESH HOME GOODIES' on yellow, 'visit the shop' script on peach. B_slice_00: magenta bar 'fun & fresh home goodies ✦ visit the shop →'.

observation: Header arrangement differs. A centers a large logo with nav items split to its left and right, each with a small italic gold label above. B puts a small logo on the left and a single right-aligned row of nav items.
evidence: A_slice_00: 'the BLOG', 'decor & INTERIORS' to the left of the logo, 'make space PODCAST' to the right. B_slice_00: logo at x=160, w=190; nav row 'BLOG … MORE ▾'.

observation: A's header nav items show small square glyph boxes where dropdown icons would be. B uses a text caret on MORE only.
evidence: A_slice_00 shows '□' after INTERIORS, PROJECTS, PODCAST and MORE. B_slice_00 shows 'MORE ▾'.

observation: The heroes differ. A has a full-width interior photo with a white overlapping card holding a signup form and large 'projects & tips' text. B has a split hero: text on the left and an arch-topped portrait image on the right.
evidence: A header1.jpg is 1440×572 at y=233, and the white card overlaps it in A_slice_00. B_slice_00–01: arch-shaped image, 4Q5A3075.jpg at x=805, w=475.

observation: B's hero image is cropped into an arch with a soft drop shadow. A's images are rectangular with no rounding.
evidence: B_slice_00–01 show the rounded arch top and shadow; B has 1 box shadow and 14 radii of 16px or more. A has 539 radii in bucket_0, one at 8–15px and one pill.

observation: B's hero sits on a soft peach-to-cream gradient. A uses no gradients.
evidence: B gradient_backgrounds 1; peach fading to cream visible in B_slice_00–01. A gradient_backgrounds 0.

observation: A shows an 'as seen in' press-logo strip on a brushed peach background. B has no press-logo section.
evidence: A_slice_01 shows HouseBeautiful, NBC News, INSIDER, Home Depot and others (as-seen-in-03-15-2021.png). None of the B slices show press logos.

observation: A has a signup form near the top, inside the hero card (First Name, Last Name, E-Mail, GO). B's only newsletter input is an email field in the footer.
evidence: A_slice_00 form fields and a square black GO button. B_slice_04 'your email' plus a pink 'subscribe' pill. Inputs: A 16, B 2.

observation: Button styles differ. A's buttons are square, black and use small letterspaced caps. B's buttons are pill-shaped, in solid black, outlined, white or pink.
evidence: A_slice_00/10/11: 'GO' and 'SEARCH' square buttons. B primary_button radius 999px, 26 pill radii; B_slice_01–03 pills such as 'about + learn more →' and 'visit the blog'.

observation: A's 'about + learn more' CTA is a plain gold text link with no padding. B renders it as a black pill with an arrow.
evidence: A primary_button text 'about + learn more', bg transparent, padding 0px, color rgb(243,179,79), as in A_slice_02. B_slice_01 shows a black pill with '→'.

observation: A uses a large standalone portrait photo, left-aligned with empty space to its right. B has no separate portrait section and folds the person image into the hero arch.
evidence: A Cara-Newhart…podcast-host-1.jpg is 1081×1081 at x=0 (A_slice_01–02), with white space on the right. B has only 4 images in total.

observation: A's welcome heading is a gold sans line spanning the full width at the far left edge. B's welcome copy sits in a padded left column.
evidence: A_slice_02: 'welcome to never skip brunch.' in gold Poppins at x≈0, paragraphs running nearly 1440px wide. B_slice_00–01: text column starting at x=160, about 580px wide.

observation: A lays out most text flush against the left viewport edge with no side padding. B uses a consistent 160px gutter.
evidence: A_slice_02, 03, 06–10: text starts at x=0. B logo at x=160, and its sections and footer align to x=160 in B_slices.

observation: A uses no CSS grid or flex layouts. B uses both.
evidence: A display_grid 0, display_flex 0. B display_grid 11, display_flex 21.

observation: The blog intro is handled differently. A overlays a huge gold 'visit' word and two 'if you . . .' lines on a photo. B shows two white rounded cards with pink script 'if you . . .' labels plus a 'browse all posts' pill.
evidence: A_slice_03: text over the paint-bar photo. B_slice_01–02: two bordered cards and a centered black pill.

observation: A includes a large 'pick a category' gold heading strip. B has no equivalent.
evidence: A_slice_03 shows 'pick a category' centered. It does not appear in B's heading outline or slices.

observation: Podcast section layout differs. A puts text over a full-width yellow damask photo with 'MAKE SPACE' in gold caps and 'podcast' in large black sans. B splits it 50/50: image left, yellow panel right with a serif title and 'space' in pink italic.
evidence: A_slice_03–04 vs B_slice_02. B MAKE-SPACE image is 785×429 at x=0, and the panel uses rgb(253,238,176).

observation: A embeds a YouTube 'SUBSCRIBE' banner image after a 'fun & fresh videos.' heading. B replaces it with a pink script label and an outlined 'watch on youtube →' pill.
evidence: A YT-SUBSCRIBE-e1589308148268.png is 1440×173 (A_slice_04). B_slice_02 shows the pill.

observation: A's blog posts are stacked vertically, each with a 1000×1556 featured image, a peach 'DIY' category bar and a gold letterspaced serif title. B shows three text-only cards in one row with 'DIY' pill tags and 'read the post →' links.
evidence: A_slice_06–08: images at y=6594/8305/9987. B_slice_02: three rounded cards with no images.

observation: One of A's post images renders as a broken-image icon, a thin 1000px-wide strip.
evidence: A_slice_05 shows the broken icon. A facts: BREAKFAST-NOOK-DIY-space-makeover.jpg natural size [0,0].

observation: A has large stretches of empty white space between sections.
evidence: A_slice_05 and A_slice_16 are almost entirely blank. A_slice_02 has about 600px of whitespace between the portrait and the welcome heading.

observation: Pagination styling differs. A lists page numbers vertically as plain gold text links. B shows them as a horizontal row of circular pills, with page 1 filled black.
evidence: A_slice_09: '2', '3', '…', '60', 'Next Page »' stacked at the left. B_slice_03: '1 2 3 … 60 Next page »' in pills.

observation: The 'coffee & let's chat' block differs. A has left-aligned 'COFFEE &' in gold caps over 'let's chat' in black, on an unshaded photo. B centers white italic serif copy over a darkened photo, with a white pill CTA.
evidence: A_slice_09 vs B_slice_03. B adds the headline 'I love connecting with women about DIY + design' as an H2.

observation: A renders its Instagram feed as huge gold vector icons, each about 1440px wide, with truncated captions above. B shows an 8-tile grid (4×2) of white rounded text cards with small pink heart icons.
evidence: A_slice_14–22: giant gold 'copy' and Instagram glyphs. A placeholder.png images are 1000×560. B_slice_03: 8 caption cards.

observation: A embeds full Instagram captions as image alt text, including hashtags and emoji. B has only 4 images, all with short descriptive or empty alt text.
evidence: A has 8 placeholder.png images with alt strings of several hundred characters. B alts: 'Never Skip Brunch by Cara Newhart', 'Cara Newhart', a sentence describing the podcast phone, and ''.

observation: A's quick links, search and social icons sit in a full-width peach section, vertically stacked, with very large black social icons. B puts them in a dark four-column footer with small white circular social buttons.
evidence: A_slice_09–11: peach rgb(255,238,224) area with icons about 140px tall. B_slice_04: rgb(28,26,25) footer with 42px circles.

observation: Quick-link numbering is formatted differently. A appends numbers directly after uppercase or mixed-case labels in gold ('BLOG01.'). B shows white sentence-case labels with small pink numbers ('Blog 01.').
evidence: A_slice_09–10: 'BLOG01.', 'Terms of Use06.', 'PODCAST06.' (06 appears twice). B_slice_04: 'Terms of use 06.', 'Podcast 07.' through 'Portfolio 10.'.

observation: Search inputs differ. A's is a full-width rectangle with a square black SEARCH button below it. B's is a rounded white input with a pink circular 'go' button beside it.
evidence: A_slice_10 vs B_slice_04.

observation: A's footer is a thin dark-gray bar with low-contrast copyright text. B's copyright sits under a divider line in the dark footer, in muted light text.
evidence: A_slice_22: rgb(51,51,51) bar, 'Copyright © 2021 · NEVER SKIP BRUNCH' in dark text, 'by Cara Newhart' in gold. B_slice_04: divider, then light-gray copyright.

observation: Heading hierarchy differs. A uses mostly H3 for nav labels (29 H3s, with empty and '. . . . . . .' entries) and H2 for post titles. B uses H2 for section titles and H3 for post titles.
evidence: A h3 count 29, including entries '' and '. . . . . . .'. B outline: h2 'visit the blog', 'make space podcast', 'new on the blog', 'on instagram'; h3 for the 3 posts.

observation: A has far more semantic sectioning elements and repeated landmarks than B.
evidence: A: header 4, footer 4, section 22, article 4, nav 2. B: header 1, footer 1, section 3, article 0, nav 1.

observation: A carries much heavier script, style and meta payloads than B.
evidence: A: scripts 74, style 19, noscript 21, link 23, meta 22, JSON-LD 1, title tags 6. B: scripts 1, style 1, link 3, meta 3, JSON-LD 0.

observation: A has no button elements. B uses 4 real buttons.
evidence: A counts.buttons 0; B counts.buttons 4.

observation: Class usage differs greatly in volume.
evidence: A classes: 699 total, 231 unique. B classes: 73 total, 35 unique. Neither uses Tailwind-like classes (A 0.003, B 0).

observation: B uses many CSS transitions. A has almost none.
evidence: B transitions 24; A transitions 1 (with 1 transform).

observation: Body text metrics differ. A uses 16px with a loose 32px line height and wide letter-spacing. B uses 17px with a 28.05px line height.
evidence: A body_font_size 16px, line_height 32px, letterspaced Poppins visible in A_slice_02. B 17px / 28.05px.

observation: H2 sizes differ.
evidence: A h2 32px weight 400 (the gold letterspaced post titles in A_slice_06–08). B h2 48px weight 400 (Playfair Display section titles).

observation: The language attribute differs in specificity.
evidence: A lang 'en-US'; B lang 'en'.

observation: A has open-graph, Twitter and verification meta tags. B has only charset, viewport and description.
evidence: A meta_names include og:*, twitter:*, google-site-verification and generator ×4. B meta_names: charset, viewport, description.

observation: A uses a large 'SIGN UP NOW' hand-drawn arrow graphic button image. B has no image-based buttons.
evidence: A signupbutton.png is 250×63 at y=1257 (A_slice_00 bottom). B's 4 images contain no button art.

observation: Total anchors and word counts are close, but A has slightly more of both.
evidence: A anchors 77, words 540. B anchors 65, words 487. Both have 6 em dashes and 3 exclamation marks; emoji A 4, B 5.

observation: B places 'hello. / join the newsletter.' as a compact footer column. A shows a large centered gold 'hello.' heading over a full-width three-field form.
evidence: A_slice_11: big 'hello.', script 'join the newsletter.', and three full-width inputs plus GO. B_slice_04: fourth footer column with one input.
